body: Hmm... yes, this does seem like a problem. The original author of the joystick implementation that makes use of udev seems to have forgotten to add it as a dependency to FindSFML.cmake. The addition needed to fix this shouldn't be too complicated, but it won't make it in before 2.2.
Why? I'd assume it's a pretty minor change and easy to test, since it's a "fix or break less often" kind of issue? So even if a fix won't  fix it everywhere, it won't get worse just due to that.
Right, I think it's quite easy to fix. Maybe I can come up with a solution on my own and contribute it.

issue.title: Updated FindSFML to add UDev to SFML's dependencies
issue.body: This fixes issue #728 - tested on Linux Mint X64.
